title: Account Mosaic: consolidate CS/Sales enterprise asks into portfolio proposals with rapid solution sketches
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success submit many overlapping enterprise feature asks (different accounts, similar intents). This creates duplicated scoping work, delayed responses to customers, and inconsistent first-pass cost/effort signals. Goal: Build a lightweight process and artifact ("Account Mosaic") that groups related asks into a single portfolio view and outputs a 1-page rapid solution proposal for each portfolio, enabling Sales/CS to communicate a consistent first-pass answer within 3 business days.

Scope:
- Aggregate similar feature asks across accounts (by intent, persona, and resources impacted).
- Produce a short portfolio summary (customer examples, common goals, priority signals, rough engineering cost band, and potential mitigations).
- Deliver a 1-page rapid solution proposal (problem statement, recommended approach, MVE, expected dependencies, and gating criteria).
- Provide a clear handoff to engineering/solutions for formal scoping or to PM for roadmap consideration.

Out of scope: full engineering Q2 roadmaps, formal security audits, multi-account legal negotiations.

Assumptions:
- CS/Sales will attach a short intake form (existing template) to each ask to capture intent, urgency, and example prompts/datasets.
- We can reuse existing cost heuristics from Optimize to produce initial cost bands.
- Small set of triage owners (PM + Solutions Engineer) will synthesize 2–3 related asks per portfolio in the first pass.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Process documented and shared with CS+Sales; 2) Triage owner can produce an "Account Mosaic" and a 1-page rapid solution proposal within 3 business days for 90% of incoming portfolios; 3) Templates and a checklist are stored in Drive/Confluence; 4) Sample pilot run executed with 4 accounts and feedback captured; 5) Clear next-step labels for Engineering / PM handoff (e.g., 'eng-scope', 'pm-review', 'customer-poc')
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with CS leadership; agreed to pilot with 4 strategic accounts (two in FinServ, one in AdTech, one in Health). CS will provide intake forms for active asks.
2026-03-04: Quick design sketch reviewed with Solutions Eng (Lina Cho) — single-page template accepted with sections: Intent summary, Customer examples, Cost band, MVE sketch, Risks & dependencies.

2026-03-06: Pulled queries from Salesforce for last 6 months; identified 27 asks that map to 5 candidate portfolios. Majority cluster around 'private deployment connectors' and 'per-route cost breakdowns'.
2026-03-08: Internal PM sync — decided to use Optimize heuristics for cost bands; assigned ENG-flag for a small tooling enhancement to export token-profile examples (ENG-92334).
2026-03-10: Pilot materials drafted and shared with CS for two accounts. Received first round of feedback: Sales requests explicit 'time-to-ship' band and a short customer-facing summary paragraph.
decision_log: 2026-03-02: Pilot scope limited to 4 accounts to validate process before scaling.
2026-03-04: One-page template accepted to minimize friction; will iterate via pilot feedback.
2026-03-08: Use Optimize cost heuristics for first-pass costing to avoid custom engineering estimates.

2026-03-09: Triage ownership model approved: PM (Marco) + Solutions Engineer (rotating) execute synthesis; CS triggers portfolio creation when 3+ similar asks observed or on request for strategic accounts.
next_steps: Finalize template in Drive and Confluence by 2026-03-12.
Run pilot synthesis for 5 candidate portfolios and deliver 1-page proposals by 2026-03-15.
Collect Sales/CS feedback and refine acceptance checklist by 2026-03-17.
If pilot success metrics met, produce playbook and train 6 CS reps during week of 2026-03-22.
